title: Sizing system for Hip Belt and Integrated Harness
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. REQ-F1 requires coverage from 5th-percentile female to 99th-percentile male. The Integrated Harness needs both waist and torso sizing. Depends on: ridebelt-anthro-001 (do those first or use their outputs if merged). Risk tier high: requires credentialed expert review before release.
objective: Define a size chart (number of sizes, ranges, adjustment overlap) for the Hip Belt and Integrated Harness from anthro-001, and the fit-check method (REQ-F3).
acceptanceCriteria: Overlap between adjacent sizes ≥ a stated margin
Merged as DRAFT only (banner intact); release requires MVP-gate Safety Engineer sign-off (GOVERNANCE.md)
